name: poc-generator
description: Given a confirmed vulnerability with location and class, generates a complete Docker-based PoC environment with a single-command trigger script.
author: OpenCode Security Research Agent
trigger: when a vulnerability is confirmed and needs a PoC

inputs.target_language: string — python | javascript | typescript | go | ruby | php | java
inputs.exploit_payload: string — known payload or TODO placeholder
inputs.title: string — report title

outputs: Dockerfile — pinned to exact vulnerable version
report_draft.md — pre-filled with title, CVSS, steps

poc_requirements.environment: Docker container pinned to exact vulnerable version, one-command setup
poc_requirements.trigger: Single script (python3 poc.py or bash poc.sh) with clear success indicator
anatomy: Verify: confirm exploitation via observable output
Impact statement: print what attacker now controls

body: Impact first (what attacker can do now)
report_structure.note: MCP/Agent prompt-injection chains are CVSS 9.x (Network/Low/None/None/Changed/High/High), not 7.x. Document the chain: injection point -> agent capability -> downstream impact.
